proposition.statement: P-RK-PLUGIN-CALLBACK-CLOSURE: in the static scope every rk_conf callback a call may run, including rd_kafka_log_buf's log callback, is a run registration or a stated default with a declared candidate; with loaded external code, extra registrations depend on the applicable pinned rk_plugin_library and flb_external_plugin outer envelopes (OP-APP-RK-CALLBACKS-VIA-POLL-CB, C04.20)
For every reached loaded artifact, exact selected build/inventory, artifact identity and required symbol/address/ABI prerequisites hold.
Every actual rk_conf invocation has its exact declared member candidate and a prior successful public registration or stated static default.
Every loaded callback invocation, including destruction and copied on_new paths, has live code and opaque context.
Every interceptor-descendant pointer and scalar resource is borrowed, with no retain/transfer/global custody and each local acquisition dropped before its activation returns.
Every loaded interceptor uses a successful public setter with the exact pinned list/union-arm candidate and permitted configuration/client lifecycle.
Every callback invocation precedes matching final unload and copied registrations retain actual loader references.
Actually loaded RK and Fluent Bit C/Go code independently meet their respectively bound proposed outer envelopes; one envelope covers no missing obligation of another.
